summary: Verified the live SAP Material lookup authorization is now working end-to-end, the crash-fix for requests.exceptions.RequestException in inventory_service.deep_backfill_uuids, and full smoke of Inventory/BOM Explorer/Purchasing Plan. Backend: GET /api/inventory confirmed 3170/3177 (99.78%) items with non-null total_value, total INR 51.61 Cr - matches review request exactly. Ran POST /api/inventory/deep-backfill-uuids live: total=7, resolved=7, still_missing=0, material_lookup_unauthorized=false - all 7 remaining items resolved, bringing coverage to 3177/3177 (100%) with total INR 51.62 Cr. Re-ran the button a 2nd/3rd time via UI to confirm idempotency: target queue correctly dropped to total=0, dialog shows 'Resolved 0 of 0... Every item already has a SAP link - nothing left to resolve', no unauthorized-warning banner (material_lookup_unauthorized=false as expected now that SAP authorization is granted).

ui_bugs.issue: Direct browser navigation to /bom-explorer (typing full URL / new page load, as opposed to in-app nav click) renders a completely blank white page (body innerText length 0). Navigating via the in-app 'BOM Explorer' nav link from another page works fine. Not verified whether this is pre-existing (not flagged in prior iterations 29-31) or a side-effect of an unrelated change; likely a client-side routing/base-path issue on hard refresh rather than related to this round's SAP fix.

action_items: Optional/low priority: investigate why a hard/direct browser load of https://<host>/bom-explorer (and possibly other non-root routes) renders blank instead of the BOM Explorer UI - works fine when navigated to via in-app link from '/'. Likely unrelated to this round's SAP/deep-backfill fix; flagging for awareness since it could affect users who bookmark/refresh a sub-route.
No action needed on the core SAP crash-fix / inventory value coverage work - fully verified working as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_service.py deep_backfill_uuids/fetch_one: confirmed the new `except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:` clause is present, placed after SAPMaterialAuthError and SAPMaterialError clauses, logs a warning, and returns (pid, None) without re-raising - matches the described crash-fix exactly and is consistent with the pattern already used elsewhere in build_inventory (line ~125) for the Standard Costs call.

Live-verified end-to-end: deep-backfill job completed with status='done' (not 'failed'), total=7/resolved=7/still_missing=0/material_lookup_unauthorized=false - proves both the new live Material lookup authorization AND the graceful-degradation code path did not crash the job.
Re-running the backfill immediately after correctly finds target queue of 0 (idempotent, _get_deep_backfill_targets correctly re-evaluates component_master.product_uuid state each call).

Inventory page 'sticky valuation' fallback (build_inventory previous_by_id logic) still intact - total value moved from 51.613 Cr to 51.616 Cr after backfill, consistent with newly-resolved items adding small incremental value rather than wiping out prior data.
